elaine (sre): quick follow-up thread from the postmortem. small set of owners + dates. react :white_check_mark: when you take something.
sam (eng-runtime): I'll own resume token + reconnect audit. aim to produce a short findings doc by 2026-03-26.
marta (eng-platform): I'll add metrics + PD rule: streaming.partial_response_count, chunk_latency histogram, and a page-if-repeats rule. PR by 2026-03-24.
devindra (ml): i'll draft model backpressure guidance (early flush + adaptive max_tokens). ETA 2026-03-28.
infra-oncall (infra): creating feature-flag for 3s keepalive and will roll for 48h during testing window.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20260328 created, ticket TICKET-3620 linked.
elaine (sre): pattern recap: partial/silent streams during node drains or autoscaler churn, usually early UTC morning.
sam (eng-runtime): hypothesis: drains can orphan in-flight streams when resume tokens aren't checkpointed. test: simulate drain + 1k streams in staging.
marta (eng-platform): saved query to correlate kubernetes.restart events -> partial_response_count will be TICKET-3620-1.
elaine (sre): owner matrix: resume audit (sam) 3/26, telemetry (marta) 3/24, client retry RFC (elaine) 3/23, model guidance (devindra) 3/28, e2e tests (sam+marta) 3/31.
teams: approve PD escalation: if partials alert fires twice in 90m -> auto-page runtime oncall?
devindra (ml): approve.
infra-oncall (infra): approve.
marta (eng-platform): will implement PD rule and short runbook link.
elaine (sre): interim mitigation: enable keepalive 3s for 48h, rollback if control-plane CPU > 70%.
ops-bot: TICKET-3620 updated with PR placeholders. Next check-in scheduled 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC.
elaine (sre): daily 10m sync in #incidents until high-priority items closed. please update tickets before sync.
